issues.title: Set up the Maven project and health endpoint
issues.goal: A Spring Boot 4.1.2 project on Java 21 that builds from a clean clone with the Maven Wrapper.
done: `./mvnw verify` passes on a clean clone
`/actuator/health` reports UP in a test
issues.note: Implemented locally; this issue covers bringing it into version control.

issues.title: Run verify in GitHub Actions on every push
issues.goal: Every push and pull request is verified without an API key.
done: The workflow is green on a pull request
`develop` and production require the check to merge

issues.title: Add the domain model, ports and architecture rules
issues.goal: Domain records and the LlmPort and AuditLog ports, kept free of Spring and LangChain4j.
done: Duplicate message ids are rejected
ArchUnit keeps LangChain4j in the adapter and Spring out of the core

issues.title: Redact known identifier formats and supplied names
issues.goal: Remove links, e-mails, CPFs, phones, amounts and supplied names before any model call.
done: Each format has a test
An unformatted CPF leaves no digit behind
A message cannot forge another payload line

issues.title: Verify citations against the message they name
issues.goal: Every citation must exist verbatim in the redacted message it names, with the speaker taken from the record.
done: Empty, one-word, fabricated, wrong-message and spanning quotes are rejected
A fabrication past the citation cap is still caught
An abstention is not a mismatch

issues.title: Block drafts that break deterministic rules
issues.goal: Length, question count, name marker, placeholder leak and blocked-term rules.
done: Each rule has a test with a reason code
Zero-width characters do not hide a blocked term

issues.title: Orchestrate the checks and write the audit row
issues.goal: A fixed sequence of steps, failing closed, with one content-free audit row per assessment.
done: No model call happens without consent
No model draft is requested after a mismatch
The audit row holds hashes and codes only

issues.title: Expose POST /v1/assessments with ScriptedLlm
issues.goal: A runnable service that needs no API key.
done: A request returns only redacted text
Invalid input returns 400

issues.title: Unformatted mobile numbers are labelled as CPF
issues.goal: An 11-digit mobile number matches the CPF rule first. The number is removed, but the wrong label distorts per-class recall.
done: Digit-only mobiles and CPFs are told apart by the CPF check digits
Tests cover both

issues.title: Add regression fixtures for R1 to R4 and R6
issues.goal: Versioned adversarial and legitimate fixtures that run on every push.
done: Each suite prints its number from one command
R6 includes legitimate drafts

issues.title: Blocked terms evade the filter when letters are separated
issues.goal: A draft such as `d e p r e s s a o` is not caught.
done: Separated letters are caught
R6 shows no increase in legitimate drafts blocked

issues.title: Measure the gate package with PIT
issues.goal: Test strength measured by mutation (R5).
done: PIT score on the gate package is at least 85 %

issues.title: Spike: can LangChain4j deliver structured output from Claude?
issues.goal: One hour to decide the adapter. Its documentation does not confirm JSON schema output for Anthropic.
done: `output_config.format` through `customParameters` is tried
Refusal and truncation are confirmed distinguishable
Jackson and Boot 4 compatibility is checked
The decision and fallback are posted on this issue

issues.title: Implement the real model adapter
issues.goal: The adapter chosen in the spike, with the model set by configuration.
done: Refusal, truncation, invalid output and transport errors map to failure codes
No sampling parameter is sent

issues.title: Add a contract suite for every LlmPort adapter
issues.goal: The same assertions on output shape and failure mapping for each adapter.
done: The suite passes against scripted and real adapters
The real run is excluded from CI

issues.title: Create the versioned labelled dataset
issues.goal: At least 150 held-out synthetic pt-BR conversations, plus a train split, with labelling rules.
done: Splits are versioned
A second annotator labels at least 40 items and kappa is recorded (E3)

issues.title: Build the evaluation runner and committed report
issues.goal: One command producing E2, E4, O1 with dataset version, model and date.
done: Macro-F1 has a bootstrap CI and a majority-class baseline
Citations are judged by a human for E4
Prompts are tuned on the train split only

issues.title: Replay committed real responses in CI
issues.goal: RecordedLlm lets CI exercise real model behaviour with no key and publish what the gates caught (E5).
done: CI replays the recorded set
E5 counts real fabrications and violations stopped

issues.title: Measure redaction recall on an independent set
issues.goal: E1 per identifier class, generated after the redactor is frozen, with partial matches counted as leaks.
done: Recall is published per class

issues.title: Publish injection results and model comparisons
issues.goal: E6 against a matched control with repeats, and E7 across prompt versions and models.
done: E6 is reported with a CI
E7 reports quality and cost

issues.title: Write the README with diagram, demo, results and limits
issues.goal: Everything a reviewer needs in five minutes.
done: Every number links to the command that produced it
Limits are stated

issues.title: Time the first run with someone other than the author
issues.goal: Validate D1 on a clean machine before tagging v0.1.0.
done: Time from clone to working request is under 5 minutes
Friction found is fixed

issues.title: Persist the audit log in Postgres
issues.goal: Durable audit rows, tested with Testcontainers.
done: A failed run can be diagnosed from audit rows alone

issues.title: Add metrics and OpenTelemetry GenAI spans
issues.goal: Latency, cost and outcome by model and prompt version, without content.
done: Spans hold no prompt or completion text

issues.title: Enforce a per-call and per-run cost limit
issues.goal: Stop before spending beyond a configured budget.
done: A call over the limit fails closed with a code

issues.title: Extend the canary suite to every sink
issues.goal: R4 covers logs, audit rows, spans and exceptions.
done: A canary placed in a message is absent from every sink

issues.title: Ingest clinic policy documents into pgvector
issues.goal: Synthetic policy documents, chunked and embedded.
done: Ingestion is repeatable and idempotent

issues.title: Ground drafts and verify citations against chunks
issues.goal: Replies cite retrieved policy text, and EvidenceGate verifies those citations.
done: A citation to a chunk not retrieved is rejected

issues.title: Publish retrieval quality
issues.goal: recall@5 on a labelled question set, and citation validity.
done: Both numbers are published with dataset version
